description:
Experience one of the most scenic and unique rides in the Bass Lake area on this guided adventure that follows the historic railroad grade used during the late 1800s logging era. The route winds through beautiful Sierra National Forest landscapes, offering a gentle and enjoyable climb along the old railroad bed where massive timber was once transported from the mountains to the sawmills below.

As we ride beneath towering pines and cedars, your guide will share stories of the region's rich logging history and the role the railroad played in shaping the Bass Lake area. The wide, gradual grade makes for a comfortable ride while providing stunning views of the surrounding forest and distant mountain ridges.

The highlight of the tour is the climb to a spectacular granite dome overlooking Bass Lake and the Sierra Nevada. Unlike many granite formations, this dome can be ridden all the way to the top, rewarding riders with breathtaking panoramic views of the lake, forests, and surrounding peaks. It's the perfect place to stop, take photos, enjoy the scenery, and experience one of the most iconic viewpoints in the region.

This unforgettable ride combines history, adventure, and some of the best scenery Bass Lake has to offer, making it an ideal experience for riders looking to explore the natural beauty and unique heritage of California's Sierra Nevada.

For riders seeking an extra challenge, there is also the option to incorporate sections of single-track mountain bike trails into the tour. These trails offer more technical terrain, tighter turns, and a true mountain biking experience while still enjoying the incredible scenery of the Bass Lake area. Your guide can customize the ride to match the group's skill level and desired level of adventure.
